lines.trans: "Esteemed municipal representative, for over eighty years this historic courtyard..."
Boss, if you talk like you're reading a tax textbook, the clerk will fall asleep standing up.
Take one deep breath first, Manager Zhou, and put all five pages into the drawer.
Into the drawer?! Then what do I say when they walk through the front gate?!
Just say: "Good afternoon, welcome to Room Nine, please sit down for a cup of hot tea!"
Let the bright glass windows, Mei's warm bread, and Teacher Song's piano do the talking for you.
Do you really think simple, warm hospitality is enough?
Warm hospitality is the very thing this old house has done best for over eighty years, Manager Zhou.
Wait—are my reading glasses perched on my forehead again right now?
Tucked safely inside your suit pocket, boss. Tie straight, leather shoes clean.
Listen—the brass bell at the courtyard gate just rang! Three o'clock on the dot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yí xià. Placed after an action verb to make a request or suggestion sound casual and brief (看一下, 等一下).

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

一分不差.gloss: not a minute off; right on the dot

meanings.en: not a minute off; right on the dot
meanings.note: Pinyin: yì fēn bù chā. Four-character idiom 一分 ('one minute/point') + 不差 ('not off at all'); yī shifts to yì before 1st-tone fēn.

examples.text: 院子门口的铜铃在下午三点整响了，一分不差。
examples.trans: The brass bell at the courtyard gate rang at three o'clock sharp, not a minute off.

examples.text: 老陈修好的那只挂钟走得极准，每天都一分不差。
examples.trans: The wall clock Chen repaired keeps time with pinpoint accuracy, not a minute off any day.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yí yàng. Pairs with 跟/和 in 跟…一样 ('the same as…').

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
examples.trans: Wait—it is dark blue, the same as yours!

examples.text: 哎呀！我跑得太急，包装看着都一样！
examples.trans: Oh no! I was running in such a rush that the wrappers all looked alike!

meanings.note: Pinyin: sān. Cardinal number 3; combines with measure words (三个) and floors (三楼).

examples.text: 不在，只有我的笔和三张旧收据！
examples.trans: Not there—only my pen and three old receipts!

examples.text: 三瓶牛奶、二十个鸡蛋、黄油、奶酪和红苹果！
examples.trans: Three bottles of milk, twenty eggs, butter, cheese, and red apples!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng. Used both as a directional verb/complement ('up, onto') and location word ('on top of').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià wǔ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个下午 ('an afternoon').

examples.text: 您尽管看，宋老师。星期一下午大堂暗。
examples.trans: Go right ahead, Teacher Song. Monday afternoon the lobby was dim.

examples.text: 先别对外面透露一个字！让两兄弟先过完这个星期五下午！
examples.trans: Not a single word to anyone outside yet! Let the two brothers have their Friday afternoon first!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià lái. Compound directional complement for downward motion or writing something down to keep.

examples.text: 快问他叫什么名字！记下来！
examples.trans: Quick, ask him what his name is! Write it down!

examples.text: 请一定写下来！三楼热水：满分十分！
examples.trans: Please be sure to write that down! Third-floor hot water: ten out of ten!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǔ. Cardinal number 9.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

examples.text: 九分钟！牛奶、鸡蛋和苹果都买来了！
examples.trans: Nine minutes! The milk, eggs, and apples are all here!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yě. Always stands directly before the verb or adjective, never at the end of a clause.

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

meanings.note: Pinyin: le. After a verb, marks completion; at the end of a sentence, signals a change of situation.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì. Measure word (量词): 件 (jiàn), e.g. 一件事 ('a matter').

examples.text: 您好好休息，有事随时按铃。
examples.trans: Rest well, ma'am; ring the bell anytime if you need anything.

examples.text: 为了一个木头小火车紧张？这事越来越怪了。
examples.trans: Nervous over a wooden toy train? This story gets stranger by the hour.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǔ. Cardinal number 5.

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 别笑话人家。
examples.trans: Don't laugh at others.

examples.text: 人家不喜欢这样。
examples.trans: Others don't like this.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shén me. Asks 'what?' on its own (什么？) or modifies a noun (什么茶 'what kind of tea').

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

meanings.note: Verb/noun dàibiǎo ('signify; representative').

examples.text: 出了这种事是不是代表不成功？
examples.trans: Does an incident like this mean it failed?

examples.text: 她代表制作部参加今天的会议。
examples.trans: She represents Production at today's meeting.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huì. Expresses either an acquired skill (会弹钢琴) or likelihood in the future (会下雨).

examples.text: 停电的时候，纸还能用。
examples.trans: Paper still works when the power goes out.

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǐ men. Plural 'you' for addressing two or more people (including polite groups).

examples.text: 太谢谢你们两位了。
examples.trans: Thank you both so very much.

examples.text: 不怪你们。只是我身上只有这件外套！
examples.trans: It is not your fault. Still, I only have this one coat on me!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàng. Introduces a likeness or example ('look like, be like').

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 他长得真像他哥哥。
examples.trans: He really looks like his older brother.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiān. Placed before the verb to sequence actions: 先…再… ('first…, then…').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Numeral bāshí ('eighty').

examples.text: 今天上午要完成八十分钟的拍摄素材。
examples.trans: This morning we need eighty minutes of usable footage.

examples.text: 这位年过八十的老歌唱家依然嗓音洪亮。
examples.trans: Past eighty, the veteran singer still has a ringing voice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chū qù. Directional compound moving from inside to outside.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

examples.text: 雨停了，我们出去走走吧。
examples.trans: The rain has stopped—let's go outside for a walk.

related.gloss: come fresh out of the oven

meanings.note: Pinyin: bàn shì yuán. Combines 办事 ('handle official business') + agent suffix 员 ('staff member').

examples.text: 市政厅的办事员星期三下午三点过来检查。
examples.trans: The city hall clerk is coming over at three on Wednesday afternoon to inspect.

examples.text: 窗口的办事员耐心地帮我们填好了表格。
examples.trans: The clerk at the counter patiently helped us fill out the form.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lì shǐ. Measure word (量词): 段, e.g. 一段历史 ('a stretch of history').

examples.text: 一位研究成都历史小院建筑的建筑师啊！
examples.trans: An architect who studies historic courtyard buildings in Chengdu!

examples.text: 这条老街已经有两百年的历史了。
examples.trans: This old street already has two hundred years of history.

related.gloss: a stretch of history (measure word 段)

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòu. Marks an action repeating, or pairs two qualities in 又A又B ('both A and B').

examples.text: 真的可以吗？看着又好看又暖和！
examples.trans: Is that really alright? It looks both lovely and warm!

examples.text: 又是深蓝色行李箱！这是宋老师的吗？
examples.trans: Another dark-blue suitcase! Is this Teacher Song's?

meanings.note: Pinyin: kǒu dài. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个口袋 ('a pocket').

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

examples.text: 告诉他们，我箱子上面口袋里有红丝带！
examples.trans: Tell them there is a red ribbon inside the top pocket of my case!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hào. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个号码 ('a number').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ma. Placed at the end of any statement to turn it into a neutral yes/no question.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: ba. At the end of a sentence, softens commands into friendly suggestions ('let's…') or asks for confirmation.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tīng. Focuses on the act of listening; add 见 or 到 (听见, 听到) for actually hearing.

examples.text: 老陈，你听到了吗？有人按了大门门铃！
examples.trans: Chen, did you hear that? Someone rang the front gate bell!

examples.text: 我在院子里老远就听到你们喊黄油了。
examples.trans: All the way out in the courtyard I heard you shouting about butter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ya. Gentle exclamation of surprise or realization.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 呀，这就是星期一火车上那只双胞胎箱子吗？
examples.trans: Oh, is this that twin suitcase from Monday's train?

meanings.note: Pinyin: ne. After a noun, asks 'what about X?' (你呢？); at the end of a statement, highlights an ongoing situation.

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hū xī. Pairs with 深 in 深呼吸 ('take a deep breath').

examples.text: 深呼吸，周经理。还没人写任何东西呢。
examples.trans: Take a deep breath, Manager Zhou. Nobody has written anything yet.

examples.text: 雨后院子里的空气呼吸起来特别舒服。
examples.trans: After the rain, the courtyard air feels wonderful to breathe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé. Joins nouns or pronouns ('A and B'), NEVER two whole clauses; also means 'with' (和你一样).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎng. Used for bells, phones, pipes, or alarms ringing or clanking.

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hē. Used for drinking tea, coffee, water, juice, AND soup in Mandarin (喝汤).

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 我还没喝早咖啡呢，千万别说急事！
examples.trans: I have not had my morning coffee yet; please do not say emergency!

meanings.note: Pinyin: huí tóu. Appears in the friendly farewell 回头见！ ('See you soon!').

examples.text: 我先去送热茶，我们回头聊！
examples.trans: Let me deliver this hot tea first—we will talk soon!

examples.text: 今天辛苦了，回头见！
examples.trans: Great work today—see you soon!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. As main verb/preposition, gives location (在院子里); before another verb, marks ongoing action ('be doing').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Neutral-tone structural particle turning a descriptive phrase into an adverb before a verb (轻轻地放 'set down gently'); distinct from noun di4 ('ground').

examples.text: 小晴整整齐齐地把茶杯排在木架上。
examples.trans: Qing arranged the teacups neatly on the wooden shelf.

examples.text: 老陈仔细地检查了每一根新电线。
examples.trans: Chen carefully checked every single new wire.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuò. Means both 'sit down' (请坐) and 'ride inside a vehicle' (坐火车 'take the train').

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?

examples.text: 您先坐下，别着急，我们马上看行李牌。
examples.trans: Please sit down first and do not worry; we will check the luggage tag right away.

meanings.note: Pinyin: duōnián. Temporal expression often used adverbially before a verb (多年攒下), with 来 as 多年来 ('for many years now'), or after 这么/那么 as a duration complement (这么多年).

examples.text: 这些资源都是我多年攒下的。
examples.trans: All of these contacts are ones I saved up over many years.

examples.text: 你做我经纪人这么多年，没想到会做出这种事。
examples.trans: You were my manager for so many years, yet I never thought you would do this.

related.gloss: over the years; for many years now
all year round; year after year

meanings.note: adverb

examples.text: 职场是一个火锅，想想真的够吓人的。
examples.trans: The workplace is a hotpot; just thinking about it is scary enough.

examples.text: 职场是一个火锅，想想真的够吓人的。
examples.trans: The workplace is a hotpot; just thinking about it is scary enough.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà mén. Measure word (量词): 扇 (shàn), e.g. 一扇大门 ('a front gate').

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

examples.text: 老陈，你听到了吗？有人按了大门门铃！
examples.trans: Chen, did you hear that? Someone rang the front gate bell!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎo. Main adjective 'good'; as a result complement after a verb, means 'ready/completed properly' (修好, 准备好).

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hào kè. Combines 好 (hào, 4th tone 'be fond of') + 客 ('guests'); frequently paired in 热情好客 ('warm and hospitable').

examples.text: 热情好客正是这栋老房子八十多年来最拿手的事。
examples.trans: Warm hospitality is the very thing this old house has been best at for over eighty years.

examples.text: 梧桐巷的街坊邻居都十分好客，见了面总爱请人喝杯热茶。
examples.trans: The neighbours on Wutong Lane are all very hospitable and love inviting people in for hot tea.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ān ān quán quán. AABB reduplication of 安全 ('safe/secure'), expressing reassuring completeness ('safe and sound').

examples.text: 您的老花镜安安全全装在西装口袋里呢，一点儿也没丢。
examples.trans: Your reading glasses are tucked safe and sound inside your suit pocket, not lost at all.

examples.text: 暴雨来临以前，大家把所有的木窗板都安安全全搬进了走廊。
examples.trans: Before the storm hit, everyone carried all the wooden shutters safe and sound into the hallway.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kè rén. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位客人 ('a guest').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zūn jìng. Combines 尊 ('honor/revere') + 敬 ('respect'); used as a polite salutation in formal speeches (尊敬的…… 'Esteemed...').

examples.text: 周经理拿着五页纸念道：“尊敬的市政代表……”
examples.trans: Holding five sheets of paper, Manager Zhou read aloud: 'Esteemed municipal representative...'

examples.text: 宋老师是整条梧桐巷最受大家尊敬的钢琴老师。
examples.trans: Teacher Song is the most respected piano teacher along the entire length of Wutong Lane.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo yuàn. Measure word (量词): 座 (zuò), e.g. 一座小院 ('a small courtyard').

examples.text: 有进步！今天小院迎接兄弟重逢——大家保持安静端庄！
examples.trans: Progress! Today our courtyard hosts a brotherly reunion—quiet dignity from everyone!

examples.text: 产权转让通知：八号小院整栋建筑将作为商业办公楼出售。
examples.trans: Property Transfer Notice: Courtyard Building Eight offered for sale as commercial offices.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù. Highlights immediacy, exact location (就在这里), or smooth consequence ('then').

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì zhèng. Measure word (量词): 项, e.g. 一项市政 ('municipal service').

examples.text: 房产信？让志豪和我看看——我管市政合同，他懂老建筑保护法！
examples.trans: A property letter? Let Zhihao and me see it—I handle municipal contracts, and he knows heritage building law!

examples.text: 市政工人正在修路边的石板。
examples.trans: Municipal workers are repairing the flagstones along the road.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gān jìng. Note first tone gān ('dry/clean'), never fourth tone.

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

examples.text: 放心吧，周经理。房间干净，毛巾也是新的。
examples.trans: Relax, Manager Zhou. The room is clean, and the towels are fresh.

座.gloss: measure word for bridges, buildings, mountains

meanings.en: measure word for bridges, buildings, mountains
meanings.note: Pinyin: zuò. Counts large, fixed structures on a base (一座石桥 'a stone bridge', 一座钟楼 'a clock tower').

examples.text: 何止认识！整整六年，每个星期五我都爬那座木楼梯教钢琴！
examples.trans: More than know it! Every Friday for six whole years I climbed those wooden stairs to teach piano!

examples.text: 前面有一座古老的石桥。
examples.trans: There is an old stone bridge ahead.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hěn. Links a subject to a simple predicate adjective without needing 是 (今天很冷 'It is cold today').

examples.text: 你好，小美，很高兴认识你！好香啊！
examples.trans: Hello, Mei, nice to meet you! Something smells wonderful!

examples.text: 没错！你已经很习惯这儿了。
examples.trans: Exactly! You already fit right in here.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wēi xiào. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个微笑 ('a smile').

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

examples.text: 哎呀！透过窗户看见周经理了？我明明加倍用力微笑了！
examples.trans: Oh dear! You spotted Manager Zhou through the window? I smiled twice as wide!

meanings.note: Pinyin: kuài. As an adjective/adverb, 'fast/quickly'; in 快…了, 'about to'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 小晴，快看里面！这不是我的箱子！
examples.trans: Qing, look inside quickly! This is not my case!

meanings.note: Pinyin: niàn. Used for reading a letter or notice out loud (念第一行 'read the first line aloud').

examples.text: 二十毫米、铜的、热水器阀门——我一路念过去！
examples.trans: Twenty millimetres, brass, water-heater valve—I will repeat it all the way!

examples.text: 十九条理由？！您是迎接哥哥，还是念火车时刻表呀？
examples.trans: Nineteen reasons?! Are you welcoming your brother or reading a train timetable?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yōu jiǔ. Combines 悠 ('far-reaching in time') + 久 ('long-lasting'); most famously collocated with 历史 ('history': 历史悠久 'rich in history').

examples.text: 八十多年来，这座历史悠久的小院一直向街坊敞开。
examples.trans: For over eighty years, this historic courtyard has always stood open to the neighbourhood.

examples.text: 成都的茶馆文化历史悠久，最讲究慢悠悠的人情味。
examples.trans: Chengdu's teahouse culture has a long-standing history and treasures unhurried human warmth.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nín. Respectful singular 'you' used with elders, teachers, and guests (您好！).

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ. First-person singular pronoun; add 的 for 'my' (我的) and 们 for 'we/us' (我们).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ men. First-person plural pronoun; add 的 for 'our' (我们的).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间房 ('a room').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng zi. Measure word (量词): 栋 (dòng), e.g. 一栋房子 ('a house').

examples.text: 所以老房子自己会打招呼？
examples.trans: So the old house says hello by itself?

examples.text: 老房子每到星期二就松一颗螺丝。坐吧。
examples.trans: Every Tuesday an old house loosens one screw. Sit down.

meanings.en: measure word for handled objects; disposal marker
meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎ. Counts items with handles or backs (一把钥匙, 一把椅子); as a preposition, fronts a definite object before an action verb.

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chōu ti. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个抽屉 ('a drawer').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 备用钥匙放在前台右边的抽屉里。
examples.trans: The spare keys are kept in the right-hand drawer at reception.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhāo dài. Combines 招 ('beckon/welcome') + 待 ('treat/attend to'), used for hosting guests with food, tea, and warmth.

examples.text: 你们真的觉得，简简单单地用热茶和面包招待客人就够了吗？
examples.trans: Do you really think simply welcoming our guests with hot tea and bread is enough?

examples.text: 每当老街坊走进小院，周经理总是笑眯眯地拿新泡的热茶招待大家。
examples.trans: Whenever old neighbours step into the courtyard, Manager Zhou always welcomes them warmly with freshly brewed tea.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ná shǒu. Literally 拿 ('hold firmly') + 手 ('in hand'): describes a skill or dish one commands with effortless mastery (最拿手的事 'what one is best at').

examples.text: 热情好客正是这栋老房子八十多年来最拿手的事呀！
examples.trans: Warm hospitality is the very thing this old house has been best at for over eighty years!

examples.text: 酥脆酸甜的杏仁柠檬挞是小美主厨最拿手的招牌甜点。
examples.trans: Crisp, tangy-sweet almond lemon tart is Head Chef Mei's signature specialty dessert.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fàng. Everyday verb for placing an object somewhere (放在桌子上).

examples.text: 我们不知道。有人放在台阶上，按了门铃。
examples.trans: We do not know. Someone set it on the step and rang the bell.

examples.text: 小勺子和餐巾放在哪里？
examples.trans: Where do the small spoons and napkins go?

related.gloss: handle with care (lift gently, set down gently)

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhěng. Combines with a measure word to mean 'the entire' (整条街 'the whole street', 整栋楼 'the whole building').

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

examples.text: 今晚半价，而且一整周早餐免费！
examples.trans: Half price tonight, plus free breakfast all week!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí hou. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 这个时候 ('this moment').

examples.text: 停电的时候，纸还能用。
examples.trans: Paper still works when the power goes out.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

meanings.note: Pinyin: míng liàng. Describes both well-lit spaces and clear, ringing musical tones.

examples.text: 擦掉灰尘以后，九号房变得格外宽敞明亮。
examples.trans: After wiping away the dust, Room Nine became remarkably spacious and bright.

examples.text: 这个琴键弹出来的声音干净又明亮。
examples.trans: The sound played by this piano key is clean and bright.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì bú shì. A-not-A affirmative-negative question tag; bù shifts to bú before 4th-tone shì.

examples.text: 我们俩是不是刚升职当上正式试吃员了？
examples.trans: Did the two of us just get promoted to official taste testers?

examples.text: 你是不是把绿色登记本夹在胳膊底下了？
examples.trans: Didn't you tuck the green guest book under your arm?

meanings.en: for; in place of; on behalf of
meanings.note: Pinyin: tì. Introduces the person you step in to help (替我念 'read it for me').

examples.text: 小晴，炒蛋真好吃，替我夸夸小美！
examples.trans: The scrambled eggs are delicious, Qing. Tell Mei my compliments!

examples.text: 放心吧，老陈，我们替你保密！
examples.trans: Rest assured, Chen—we will keep your secret!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuì. Superlative adverb placed before adjectives or feeling verbs (最好 'best', 最喜欢 'like best').

examples.text: 只有裙子、乐谱，还有我最喜欢的茶杯！
examples.trans: Only dresses, sheet music, and my favourite teacup!

examples.text: 最上面架子上金色包装那包。怎么了？
examples.trans: The gold-wrapped packet on the top shelf. Why?

meanings.note: Pinyin: lái. Movement toward the speaker, as main verb or directional complement (进来 'come in').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

来到.gloss: to come to; to arrive at

meanings.en: to come to; to arrive at (a place or stage)
meanings.note: láidào — verb-complement compound (来 + 到) that directly takes a location noun phrase as its object, especially common in 欢迎来到… (welcome to…).

examples.text: 欢迎来到星天，这会儿正在录像呢。
examples.trans: Welcome to Xingtian; they are taping right at this moment.

examples.text: 欢迎大家来到《十二歌王》的现场！
examples.trans: Welcome everyone to the live studio of Twelve Kings of Song!

related.gloss: to attend; to be present in person

杯.gloss: measure word for cups and glasses

meanings.en: measure word for cups and glasses
meanings.note: Pinyin: bēi. Counts cups of tea, coffee, water, or juice (一杯热茶 'a cup of hot tea').

examples.text: 太客气了，周经理。半杯就好。
examples.trans: How polite of you, Manager Zhou. Half a glass is fine.

examples.text: 坐下吧，小晴！早上你跑了半条街，喝杯咖啡。
examples.trans: Sit down, Qing! You ran half the street this morning—drink a cup of coffee.

架.gloss: measure word for pianos, planes, framed machines

meanings.en: measure word for pianos, planes, framed machines
meanings.note: Pinyin: jià. Counts pianos, airplanes, and framed instruments (一架钢琴 'a piano').

examples.text: 三年前爷爷去世以后，我和志鹏因为卖老房子大吵了一架。
examples.trans: Three years ago after Grandfather passed away, Zhipeng and I argued bitterly over selling the old house.

examples.text: 客厅角落里放着一架老钢琴。
examples.trans: An old piano stands in the corner of the living room.

栋.gloss: measure word for buildings and houses

meanings.en: measure word for buildings and houses
meanings.note: Pinyin: dòng. Counts whole standalone buildings (一栋老房子 'an old building').

examples.text: 二十五年前？就在同一栋房子里？
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago? Right inside that very same house?

examples.text: 产权转让通知：八号小院整栋建筑将作为商业办公楼出售。
examples.trans: Property Transfer Notice: Courtyard Building Eight offered for sale as commercial offices.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huān yíng. Warm greeting to arriving guests (欢迎！ / 欢迎光临！).

examples.text: 大家早上好！欢迎你，小晴。都准备好了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning, everyone! Welcome, Qing. Is everything ready?

examples.text: 欢迎光临！早上好，您好！
examples.trans: Welcome! Good morning, hello!

meanings.en: right in the middle of; squarely; right
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèng. Before a verb, marks an action in progress right now; before 对着, means 'directly/squarely'.

examples.text: 正合我心意。楼梯在哪儿？
examples.trans: Just what I wanted. Where are the stairs?

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

examples.text: 我们的战略合作也签约了，现在正是我们有余力开发新项目的时候。
examples.trans: Our overseas strategic partnership is signed too, so right now is the exact moment we have the strength to develop new projects.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shēn. Describes deep breaths (深呼吸) or dark shades of color (深蓝色 'dark blue').

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
examples.trans: Wait—it is dark blue, the same as yours!

examples.text: 又是深蓝色行李箱！这是宋老师的吗？
examples.trans: Another dark-blue suitcase! Is this Teacher Song's?

meanings.note: Pinyin: diǎn. Marks hours on the clock (八点 'eight o'clock') or 'a bit' (一点).

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: rè. Describes hot tea, hot water, or warm weather.

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

meanings.note: Adjective rèqíng ('warmhearted, enthusiastic').

examples.text: 现场聚集了许多热情的观众朋友们。
examples.trans: Many enthusiastic audience friends gathered on site.

examples.text: 林姐对新来的同事其实很热情。
examples.trans: Lin Jie is actually warm toward hardworking newcomers.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàn zài. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 现在这时候 ('this moment right now').

examples.text: 现在他的箱子还安全锁着呢。
examples.trans: For now, his suitcase stays safely locked up.

examples.text: 太好了！现在我想吃一顿丰盛的早餐。
examples.trans: Wonderful! Now I would like to eat a big breakfast.

related.gloss: this moment right now (measure word 个)

meanings.note: Pinyin: bō li. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块玻璃 ('a pane of glass').

examples.text: 小晴，隔着玻璃看——他们俩在树下面对面站着呢！
examples.trans: Qing, look through the glass—the two of them are standing face to face under the tree!

examples.text: 擦干净玻璃窗以后，屋里亮多了。
examples.trans: After wiping the glass window clean, the room is much brighter.

related.gloss: a pane of glass (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Links modifiers or owners to nouns (我的书 'my book', 安静的院子 'quiet courtyard').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: pí xié. Measure word (量词): 双 (shuāng), e.g. 一双皮鞋 ('a pair of leather shoes').

examples.text: 怪不得这么重，全是木头和皮鞋！
examples.trans: No wonder it was so heavy—all wood and leather shoes!

examples.text: 下雨天出门，最好别穿新皮鞋。
examples.trans: Heading out in the rain, it is best not to wear new leather shoes.

related.gloss: a pair of leather shoes (measure word 双)

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhēn de. Used standalone ('Really?!' 真的吗？！) or before verbs as an emphatic adverb.

examples.text: 真的吗？！你真的把火车票改到星期六早上了？
examples.trans: Really?! Did you really move your train ticket to Saturday morning?

examples.text: 加了杏仁粉的柠檬挞真的特别香！
examples.trans: The lemon tart made with almond flour is truly fragrant!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhe. Placed right after a verb to show a state or posture continues (门开着 'the door stands open').

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

examples.text: 淳于总是睡着了吗？
examples.trans: Has Director Chun Yu fallen asleep?

examples.text: 淳于总是睡着了吗？
examples.trans: Has Director Chun Yu fallen asleep?

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuì wù. Combines 税 ('tax/duty') + 务 ('administrative affairs').

examples.text: 老陈笑道：“老板，您要是像念税务课本一样说话，办事员站着都会睡着！”
examples.trans: Chen chuckled, 'Boss, if you talk like you're reading a tax textbook aloud, the clerk will fall asleep standing up!'

examples.text: 每个月底，周经理都会在账房里仔细整理客栈的账本和税务表格。
examples.trans: At the end of every month, Manager Zhou carefully organizes the inn's ledgers and tax forms in the office.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chuāng. Measure word (量词): 扇 (shàn), e.g. 一扇窗 ('a window').

examples.text: 一点也不介意！窗下这张宽书桌正适合我工作。
examples.trans: Not at all! And this wide desk beneath the window suits my work ideally.

examples.text: 打开木窗就能看见院子里的老树。
examples.trans: Open the wooden window and you can see the old tree in the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhàn. As a verb, 'stand' (站在旁边); as a noun, 'station/stop' (火车站).

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

examples.text: 听得很清楚。你站在小石头喷泉旁边吗？
examples.trans: Loud and clear. Are you standing beside the little stone fountain?

meanings.note: Pinyin: děng deng. Urgent or casual reduplication of 等 ('wait!').

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
examples.trans: Wait—it is dark blue, the same as yours!

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎn jiǎn dān dān. AABB reduplication of 简单 ('simple'), emphasizing warmth, sincerity, and lack of fuss; takes 地 before verbs.

examples.text: 你们真的觉得，简简单单地招待客人就比念五页演讲稿更好吗？
examples.trans: Do you really think welcoming our guests nice and simply is better than reading a five-page speech?

examples.text: 一碗热扁豆汤配两片脆皮面包，简简单单却让人吃得心里暖洋洋的。
examples.trans: A bowl of hot lentil soup with two slices of crusty bread is simple and unpretentious, yet warms the heart.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张纸 ('a sheet of paper').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

related.gloss: a sheet of paper (measure word 张)

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo. Describes longtime friends, historic lanes, or warm respect before a colleague's surname (老陈).

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 所以老房子自己会打招呼？
examples.trans: So the old house says hello by itself?

meanings.note: Pinyin: láo bǎn. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位老板 ('a boss / shop owner').

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

examples.text: 老板正在开锁呢！别挂电话，等我一秒钟。
examples.trans: The owner is unlocking it right now! Stay on the phone, wait one second.

related.gloss: a boss / shop owner (measure word 位)

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo huā jìng. Combines 老花 ('presbyopia / farsightedness of middle age') + 镜 ('glasses/lenses'); measure word: 副 (fù).

examples.text: 周经理摸了摸额头问：“等等——我的老花镜现在是不是又架在额头上？”
examples.trans: Manager Zhou felt his forehead and asked, 'Wait—are my reading glasses perched up on my forehead again right now?'

examples.text: 老陈看细小的钢琴零件时，总会从口袋里拿出那副老花镜戴上。
examples.trans: Whenever Chen inspects tiny piano parts, he takes that pair of reading glasses out of his pocket and puts them on.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chá. Measure word (量词): 杯 (bēi), e.g. 一杯茶 ('a cup of tea').

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 先喝杯热茶，吃个肉桂卷坐十分钟吧！
examples.trans: Have a cup of hot tea and a cinnamon roll for ten minutes first!

related.gloss: a cup of tea (measure word 杯)

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuāng. Used for packing items into a bag/box (装进) or fitting hardware.

examples.text: 我来帮您。哎呀，里面装了石头吗？
examples.trans: Let me help you. Goodness, did you pack stones inside?

examples.text: 他没要回那个装木头小火车的箱子吗？
examples.trans: Did he not ask back for that case with the wooden train?

meanings.note: Pinyin: xī zhuāng. Combines 西 ('Western') + 装 ('attire/suit'); measure word: 套 (tào, full suit) or 件 (jiàn, suit jacket).

examples.text: 老陈笑着说：“您的老花镜安安全全装在西装口袋里呢，老板！”
examples.trans: Chen smiled and said, 'Your reading glasses are tucked safe and sound in your suit pocket, boss!'

examples.text: 为了迎接下午三点的审核，周经理特意穿上了一套整洁的深蓝西装。
examples.trans: To welcome the three-o'clock review, Manager Zhou put on a neat dark-blue suit.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yào shi. Everyday spoken 'if', often paired with 就 in the main clause.

examples.text: 等等——要是每天早上打开院门，卖街坊咖啡和热面包……
examples.trans: Wait—if we open our courtyard gate every morning for neighbourhood coffee and warm bread...

examples.text: 周经理，要是你不正式聘用她，我就请她进我厨房！
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, if you do not hire her permanently, I am hiring her into my kitchen!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiàn. Appears in farewells (再见, 明天见) and as result complement of perception (看见, 听见).

examples.text: 晚安，小晴。明天早餐见。
examples.trans: Good night, Qing. See you at breakfast tomorrow.

examples.text: 老陈，听得见吗？我刚经过绿药店！
examples.trans: Chen, can you hear me? I just passed the green pharmacy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jué de. Introduces personal impressions or feelings.

examples.text: 周经理的意思是……希望每位客人都觉得有十分满意！
examples.trans: What Manager Zhou means is... we hope every guest feels ten-out-of-ten satisfied!

examples.text: 我觉得这间向阳的书房最安静。
examples.trans: I think this sunny study is the quietest room of all.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ràng. Everyday causative/polite-offer verb (让我看看 'let me have a look').

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 宋老师，让我来给您倒新鲜橙汁！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, allow me to pour fresh orange juice for you!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuō. Most common verb of speaking.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

examples.text: 我还没喝早咖啡呢，千万别说急事！
examples.trans: I have not had my morning coffee yet; please do not say emergency!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuō huà. Separable verb-object compound ('speak words').

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 从那天起我们就再没说过话。上周我给他寄了一张明信片。
examples.trans: Since that day we have not spoken again. Last week I mailed him a postcard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qǐng. At the start of a request, means 'please' (请进, 请坐, 请问); before a person, 'invite / treat'.

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

meanings.note: Pinyin: kè běn. Combines 课 ('lesson/course') + 本 ('bound book'); measure word: 本 (běn) or 册 (cè).

examples.text: 您要是像念税务课本一样一字一句地念演讲稿，客人站着都会睡着。
examples.trans: If you read your speech word for word like a tax textbook, our guest will fall asleep standing up.

examples.text: 隔壁书店的架子上既有文学小说，也有音乐学院用的钢琴课本。
examples.trans: On the shelves of the bookshop next door are both literary novels and piano textbooks used at the conservatory.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǒu. Means 'walk' (走路, 直走) or 'leave / head off' (我先走了).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yíng jiē. Used for stepping out to greet an arriving guest.

examples.text: 十九条理由？！您是迎接哥哥，还是念火车时刻表呀？
examples.trans: Nineteen reasons?! Are you welcoming your brother or reading a train timetable?

examples.text: 有进步！今天小院迎接兄弟重逢——大家保持安静端庄！
examples.trans: Progress! Today our courtyard hosts a brotherly reunion—quiet dignity from everyone!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè. Proximal demonstrative; pairs with a measure word before nouns (这个 'this one', 这间房 'this room').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jìn. Movement into an enclosed space (请进 'come in!', 倒进 'pour into').

examples.text: 小晴，把热水倒进茶壶里，他们来了！
examples.trans: Qing, pour the hot water into the teapot—here they come!

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà. Distal demonstrative before measure words (那个 'that one'); at clause start, means 'then / well then'.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dōu. Summarizes everything BEFORE it and always stands directly before the verb/adjective (我们都喜欢).

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǐ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 里面 ('the inside').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāng qín. Measure word (量词): 架 (jià), e.g. 一架钢琴 ('a piano').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 何止认识！整整六年，每个星期五我都爬那座木楼梯教钢琴！
examples.trans: More than know it! Every Friday for six whole years I climbed those wooden stairs to teach piano!

meanings.note: Pinyin: líng. Measure word (量词): 只 (zhǐ), e.g. 一只铃铛 ('a small bell').

examples.text: 您好好休息，有事随时按铃。
examples.trans: Rest well, ma'am; ring the bell anytime if you need anything.

examples.text: 有客人按了前台的小铜铃。
examples.trans: A guest rang the small brass bell at reception.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tóng. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块铜 ('a piece of brass').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 楼下我的工具房里有一盏铜台灯。
examples.trans: Downstairs in my workshop there is a brass desk lamp.

related.gloss: a piece of brass (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: mén kǒu. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 大门口 ('at the doorway').

examples.text: 等等——那星期一晚上门口台阶……第二个蓝箱子……
examples.trans: Wait—then Monday night on our front step... the second blue suitcase...

examples.text: 您为什么不直接去志鹏家门口把木头小火车交给他呢？
examples.trans: Why not go straight to Zhipeng's door and hand him the wooden train?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuàn zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个院子 ('a courtyard').

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: miàn bāo. Measure word (量词): 片 (piàn), e.g. 一片面包 ('a slice of bread').

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 闻闻看！热面包、热炒蛋，还有新鲜香草。
examples.trans: Smell that! Warm bread, hot scrambled eggs, and fresh herbs.

related.gloss: a slice of bread (measure word 片)

meanings.note: Pinyin: yè. Counts pages directly without 个 (第二页 'page two').

examples.text: 当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
examples.trans: Of course we must not peek... oh, it fell open to the middle page by itself!

examples.text: 仔细看这一页——记的是分贝和安静度，不是酒店星级！
examples.trans: Look closely at this page—it records decibels and quietness, not hotel stars!

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǐng dài. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条领带 ('a necktie').

examples.text: 天哪！桌子上一滴没洒……全洒在我领带上了！
examples.trans: Good heavens! Not a drop spilled on the table... it all spilled on my tie!

examples.text: 小晴，今天我的领带怎么样？一滴橙汁都没有！
examples.trans: Qing, how does my tie look today? Not a single drop of orange juice!

meanings.note: Pinyin: é tóu. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个额头 ('a forehead').

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

examples.text: 笔挺又干净，周经理！连眼镜都戴在鼻子上，没在额头上。
examples.trans: Crisp and spotless, Manager Zhou! Even your glasses are on your nose instead of your forehead.
